failure_contract.detail: Session is already bound to a different presentation
Presentation evaluation is already in progress

invariants: OID4VP and DCQL artifacts are produced by the canonical Rust flow and marty-core implementation
standalone callbacks and trust or deployment profile overrides are rejected in favor of the Flow service
SIOPv2 id_token sessions do not require a presentation policy and emit scope openid without DCQL
wallet request and submission routes remain public while management routes are tenant authorized
pending sessions privately retain the authenticated initiating principal and propagate it to Presentation Policy evaluation
terminal session minimization removes the initiating principal
one presentation digest owns a session and duplicate submissions reuse the canonical terminal result
Redis server time controls expiry and lease recovery across replicas
claim transitions preserve the original session TTL and terminal writes are lease fenced
raw presentation tokens, disclosed values, inspection payloads, and callback destinations are never retained in terminal records
deployed environments require Redis and workload-authenticated control-plane providers
optional inspection failure is non-fatal and never exposes raw inspection material
